scope.label: Coding-agent skills ecosystem
scope.description: A curated subset; absence is not a classification.

categories.label: Verification & QA
categories.definition: Testing, validation, code review, spec-compliance, and correctness-checking skills.

categories.label: Security
categories.definition: Security audit, pentest, recon, and vulnerability-scanning skills.

categories.label: Roadmap & Spec-Driven Planning
categories.definition: Planning, spec-driven dev, task/project management, and roadmapping skills/methodologies.

categories.label: Design (UI/UX & Visual/Motion)
categories.definition: UI/UX, visual, motion, and graphic design skills.

categories.label: Marketing, SEO & Social Content
categories.definition: Marketing, SEO, ads, growth, and social-content creation/ops skills.

categories.label: Video Editing & Generation
categories.definition: Video and media editing, production, and generation skills.

categories.label: Research & Web Intelligence
categories.definition: Open-web/topic research, multi-source search, and synthesis skills.

categories.label: Writing & Content
categories.definition: Long-form writing, editing, and content-authoring skills (non-marketing).

categories.label: Finance & Trading
categories.definition: Investing, trading, equity research, and market-analysis skills.

categories.label: Docs & Knowledge Base
categories.definition: Documentation, knowledge-base, and notebook/knowledge-graph authoring skills.

categories.label: Presentations & Slide Decks
categories.definition: Slide-deck and presentation generation skills.

categories.label: Data Viz & Diagramming
categories.definition: Chart, infographic, and diagram generation skills.

categories.label: Codebase Understanding & Context Engineering
categories.definition: Skill-level (non-MCP) tools for mapping and explaining a codebase.

categories.label: Localization & Translation
categories.definition: Cross-language translation and localization skills.

categories.label: Career & Job Search
categories.definition: Job search, CV tailoring, and application-tracking skills.

categories.label: Personal Productivity & Lifestyle
categories.definition: Persona distillation, personal knowledge work, and lifestyle skills.

categories.label: Game Development
categories.definition: Skills for building and producing games.

categories.label: Browser & Scraping Automation
categories.definition: Skill/CLI-packaged (non-MCP) browser automation and web scraping.

categories.label: MCP Integrations
categories.definition: MCP servers connecting agents to external data/tools/APIs, any domain.

categories.label: Agent Harnesses & Orchestration
categories.definition: Harnesses, multi-agent coordination, fleets, and autonomous execution loops.

categories.label: Routers & Proxies
categories.definition: LLM/model request routing and API-compatibility proxy layers.

categories.label: Memory & Context Infra
categories.definition: Cross-session memory, context compression, and persistence layers.

categories.label: Agent UX, Config & Hooks
categories.definition: Statuslines, hooks, behavior configs, and agent-interface tweaks.

categories.label: Skill/Plugin Collections & Meta-Frameworks
categories.definition: Multi-domain skill catalogs, marketplaces, and skill-management tooling.
